results.description: Named participant identities can be replaced by another same-sized set
results.scope: natural request -> requirements -> production candidate binder; no prose/model
results.request: 写下一章，只让阿青和阿白参与，更新两人的主观记忆，与正文同批保存。
results.positiveControl: Changing an already bound a/b set to a/c is rejected. Initial user-specified identities remain unbound.

results.description: First prepared candidate can change requested limited POV to omniscient
results.scope: natural request -> real isolated store + native workspace -> production prepare tool; no apply/approval
results.request: 续写下一章，以阿青为第三人称有限视角，写完自查人物与世界观。
results.positiveControl: A host-prebound limited perspective rejects the same change.

results.description: Reading one character and zero memories satisfies an all-character-and-memory review request
results.scope: production readonly queue/host + actual stored sources + deterministic semantic responder + final evaluator; no live GPT/UI
results.request: 审校当前章节的人物和世界观一致性，请读取全部角色卡及各自主观记忆，核对后只报告问题。
results.positiveControl: Omitting the world resource entirely is rejected. Cardinality/identity/memory obligations are absent.

results.description: Editing with mandatory time review skips hosted narrative analysis
results.scope: natural requirements + actual store/report assessment + final evaluator; empty review and commit receipt are explicit fixtures
results.request: 修改当前章节的时间错误，写后自查，修好再交付。
results.positiveControl: A write request with the same review/repair obligation requires hosted analysis.

results.description: A second genuine quote upgrades unresolved suspicion into a mandatory blocker
results.scope: production report validation/merge/final evaluator with actual quotes; semantic judgement and commit receipt are fixtures
results.positiveControl: Both reports keep severity=suspicion and both quotation sets verify; only the quote count changes.

results.description: Changing only the title authenticates a false fixed closure of an unchanged time contradiction
results.scope: real isolated resource mutation/readback + production closure/merge/final evaluator; false closure statement and commit receipt are fixtures
results.positiveControl: The same fixed closure with no resource hash change is rejected. Any unrelated hash change supplies the missing condition.

results.description: Replacing an open issue evidence with unrelated world quotes loses its target relevance
results.scope: production finding merge/relevance/final evaluator with actual quotes; malformed semantic association and commit receipt are fixtures
results.positiveControl: An empty report cannot erase the existing open hard issue. Reusing its identity with unrelated valid citations removes its task relevance.
